title: Sony pulled the most hyped game of 2020 off the PlayStation Store
caption: Cyberpunk 2077 got pulled from the PlayStation Store, then came back with Update 2.0 and Phantom Liberty and sold 30 million copies. Redemption arc or still unforgivable? #cyberpunk2077 #cdprojektred #keanureeves #phantomliberty #gaming #gamingfacts
test: Frame twibbon padat visual, topik baru. Drama rilis ancur lalu comeback, studio yang sama kayak post Witcher 60k. Penutup berpihak (Redemption arc, or still unforgivable?) plus pin komen pedes.
prediction: Durasi nonton ~10 detik kayak Kojima, dan minimal beberapa komen karena orang suka debat Cyberpunk.

title: Konami pushed out the man who made Metal Gear (padat visual, frame twibbon)
caption: Konami took Kojima's name off Metal Gear Solid V, cancelled Silent Hills and kept him from accepting his own award at The Game Awards. Team Kojima or Team Konami? #metalgearsolid #kojima #konami #deathstranding #gaming #gamingfacts
test: Cerita Kojima yang sama, tapi tiap slide padat visual: muka Kojima, logo MGS/Konami, momen Game Awards, Death Stranding. Penutup dibikin berpihak (Team Kojima or Team Konami?) plus pin komen pedes.
prediction: Durasi nonton sama atau lebih tinggi dari versi pertama (10 detik), dan ada komen. Kalo views tetep mentok ~400 dengan 0 komen, masalahnya bukan di visual.

title: Minecraft's creator got billions and felt more alone than ever
caption: Microsoft paid $2.5 billion for Minecraft. Its creator bought a $70 million mansion, then said he had never felt more isolated. Would you take the money? #minecraft #notch #mojang #microsoft #gaming #gamingfacts
test: Gaya lama (foto di atas, panel putih, logo game) + foto asli orang/tempat yang dibahas. Fakta satu cerita besar soal uang, tapi kebalikan dari post Witcher 60k: kreatornya dapet miliaran dan tetep nggak bahagia.
prediction: 3–15k views. Kalo kalah jauh dari Witcher, berarti yang bikin rame itu rasa nggak adil, bukan sekadar angka besar.
result: 195 views, rata-rata 6,7 detik, 23,6% nonton sampe habis, 1 like, 0 komen, 0 share. Tebakan 3–15k salah.

title: Konami pushed out the man who made Metal Gear
caption: Konami took Kojima's name off Metal Gear Solid V, cancelled Silent Hills and kept him from The Game Awards. Who was right? #metalgearsolid #kojima #konami #deathstranding #gaming #gamingfacts
test: Gaya lama (foto di atas, panel putih, logo game) + foto asli orang/tempat yang dibahas. Format sama, tapi ceritanya drama yang memancing debat (Kojima vs Konami).
prediction: 1–5k views, tapi komennya lebih banyak dari Witcher.
result: 455 views (360 hari pertama), rata-rata 10,2 detik, 39,5% nonton sampe habis, 18 like, 0 komen, 0 share, 1 save. Retensi jauh lebih bagus dari PS2 (4,9 detik / 16%), tapi views berhenti setelah batch pertama.
